pattern: presentation read as a dimension
evidence: OpenCascade's reader turns a presentation-only callout (DRAUGHTING_CALLOUT / annotation occurrence with no semantic dimension; specify-core's own thread and knurl callouts, NIST's graphic PMI) into a 'DimensionPresentation' dimension of value 0.0. It states no size; haecceity reads semantic PMI only (every Python item of this type has value 0.0).

pattern: a location dimension the file states without a value
evidence: #24=DIMENSIONAL_LOCATION('linear distance',$,#324,#325) has no dimensional_characteristic_representation (haecceity's finding: nonconformance, §5.2.1). Rust reports Location_LinearDistance, as named, with no value; OpenCascade falls back to its default type Location_None and invents 0.0.

pattern: datum letters repeated by OpenCascade
evidence: Python lists [A, A, B, B, B, B, C]: OpenCascade builds a datum per datum target (A1-A3, B1-B4, C1) of each tolerance's datum system; the system is A|B|C, which Rust reports once each, primary first.

pattern: a datum established by targets alone, reported without faces
evidence: Datums A, B and C are established by point datum targets only (A1-A3, B1-B4, C1; no datum feature): haecceity reads them with no faces; OpenCascade's reader drops them although every tolerance cites them, so specify-core would offer A, B, C again.

pattern: a datum no tolerance references
evidence: Datum D is in the file (DATUM 'D', datum feature on face 1); OpenCascade's reader builds datums only through the tolerances citing them, and none cites D.

pattern: a datum on a surface model's face

pattern: PMI on a feature naming the whole solid
evidence: Two diameters (12, 20±0.3) and a position (0.75 |A|B|C) apply to a shape aspect whose item is the MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP (haecceity: unresolved-reference finding): Rust reports them with no faces; Python, whose XCAF split makes this part one of several, drops PMI with no faces as another part's (existing._elsewhere).

pattern: a tolerance on a surface model's face
evidence: Question Q7: OpenCascade's XCAF makes a part of each shape representation of one product; haecceity has one part per product definition, so Python's parts 1 and 2 (one surface face each) do not exist in Rust. Face 483 is the surface model's face, which Python's part 0 lacks.

pattern: inch values reported in millimetres
evidence: The file's length unit is the inch: Python reports 5.0, Rust 127.0 mm (5 x 25.4).

pattern: specify-core's stored answers are not PMI
evidence: haecceity reports Python's PROPERTY_DEFINITION('pmi-assist answers') as a property it does not model; it is specify-core's stored answers, read by resume (resume.rs), not existing PMI.

pattern: haecceity reports nonconformance findings
evidence: haecceity reads through constructs that break the PMI practice and says so (e.g. a datum feature that identifies no face, a dimension with no value, a shape aspect naming no face); OpenCascade's reader is silent. Reporting is the honest form (R10).

pattern: haecceity reports not-modelled findings
evidence: haecceity reports what it consumes without holding (CATIA geometric sets, 'designed' qualifiers, unknown properties); OpenCascade is silent.

pattern: haecceity reports unconsumed findings
evidence: haecceity lists semantic-PMI instances no part's PMI reaches (CTC-04's usage of an aspect naming the solid, CTC-05's unused qualifiers); OpenCascade is silent.

pattern: haecceity reports unresolved-reference findings
evidence: haecceity reports a feature it cannot anchor (CTC-04: an aspect naming the MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP); OpenCascade is silent.
